apiRejected: The site API rejected the request: {reason}
xmlExtrasFailed: [safebooru] Failed to read post dates from XML on page {page} (downloads are unaffected): {error}
commentsFetchFailed: [safebooru] Failed to fetch comments for post {id} (got {count}, downloads are unaffected): {error}
noMediaUrl: [safebooru] Post {id} has no media URL; skipping
pagerLocatedByHops: [safebooru] Page {page} is past the API paging limit; located id<{id} with {hops} ID-cursor hop(s)
pagerContinueFromLast: [safebooru] Page {page} is past the API paging limit; continuing after id<{id} from the previous page
offsetLimit: Page {page} is past the site API paging limit: the starting offset may be at most {maxOffset} posts (page {lastPage} at {perPage} per page). Sorting by “{sort}” cannot page past this point; only “Newest” (no sort: metatag) can continue further. You can also narrow the tags so the total result count falls within the limit
endPageBeforeStart: The end page must be greater than the start page
pageRangeTooLarge: A single run cannot crawl more than 100 pages. Please crawl responsibly
positiveIntegerRequired: {label} must be a positive integer; current value: “{value}”
endIdBeforeStart: End ID ({endId}) must be at least the start ID ({startId})
idRangeTooLarge: The ID range may span at most {max}; {startId}..{endId} spans {span}
tagsRequired: Tag mode requires at least one tag
